headline: MacKinnon (lower-body) will not play Saturday in Montreal.
Kaprizov (undisclosed) will play Sunday vs. the Blue Jackets.
Guentzel (rest) will not play against the Rangers on Wednesday.
Nylander (illness) is on the ice for warmups; he's expected to play vs. the Sharks.
Oettinger will start Saturday vs. the Sabres.
Schaefer (illness) will play vs. New Jersey on Tuesday.
news: Schaefer was absent from practice on Monday due to illness, but he attended the team's morning skate on Tuesday and will be in the lineup in the evening against the New Jersey Devils. The 18-year-old rookie's tremendous season continued in the Islanders' most recent game, recording two goals, including the overtime winner, in a 4-3 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs. He has 28 points (12G / 16A) in 42 games this season.

headline: Marner (personal) returned to practice on Monday.
news: Marner has missed the past two games, tending to a personal matter, but was back at practice on Monday and will likely be back in the lineup on Tuesday against the Ottawa Senators. The 29-year-old Marner is off to a strong start this season, with 12 points (2G / 10A) in 11 games.

headline: Bedard (shoulder) is expected to make his season debut vs. Pittsburgh on Tuesday.
news: Bedard missed all of training camp and the opening six games of the season, but he should make his debut on Tuesday against the Pittsburgh Penguins. The Blackhawks can't afford to go much longer without their 21-year-old superstar after scoring just 12 goals in their first six games (1-5-0). Bedard had 30 goals, 75 points and 226 SOG in 69 GP last season.

headline: Point (undisclosed) has been placed on IR.
news: Point played only 5:35 time-on-ice in Sunday's 4-3 loss to the Winnipeg Jets before leaving the game with an undisclosed injury. Following the game, Head Coach Jon Cooper was hopeful that Point's injury was not severe, but suggested that he could "miss some time," which was reaffirmed when he was placed on IR on Tuesday. The 30-year-old Point was starting to heat up before his injury, scoring 10 points (4G / 6A) during a seven-game point streak.

headline: 2-year, $18,000,000 contract with the Vegas Golden Knights. Breakdown to be confirmed . Expires 2029 (UFA).
Blake (rest) is expected to be back in the Hurricanes' lineup on Monday.
news: With Carolina locking up their playoff position over the weekend, Jackson Blake found himself out of the lineup due to rest related purposes but will draw back into the lineup vs. Philadelphia on Monday. The 22-year-old forward has taken a massive step forward in his second NHL season, picking up career highs in goals (22), assists (30), points (52), PIMs (40) and SOG (167) through 79 games played.

headline: Lafreniere (illness) is expected to play vs. Buffalo on Thursday.
news: The Rangers are battling a myriad of key injuries and had a scare on Wednesday when Lafreneiere was absent from practice because of an illness, but he should play on Thursday against the Buffalo Sabres. The 24-year-old Lafreniere has been held off the scoresheet in 28 of 44 games this season and continues to be unable to live up to the expectations he garnered when he was drafted first overall in the 2020 NHL Entry Draft. He has 24 points (9G / 15A) in 44 games this season.

headline: Stankoven (illness) missed practice on Thursday.
news: Stankoven is battling an illness and did not practice on Thursday, but will be hopeful to play when Carolina opens the postseason on Saturday. Stankoven has been an effective offensive contributor in his previous two postseasons and hopes to carry his late-season momentum into a deep playoff run for the Hurricanes. The 23-year-old has nine points (7G / 2A) during a six-game point streak.

headline: Jarry will start vs. Philadelphia on Wednesday.
news: The Oilers have returned to relying on Devon Levi since his return from a lower-body injury, but the team hopes that Jarry can continue the success he had during that stretch. Jarry was solid in his most recent outing, saving 31 of 34 shots (.912 SV%), but fell to a 4-3 shootout loss to the New Jersey Devils. The 31-year-old goalie is playing his best since joining the Oilers, posting a 2.09 GAA and .923 SV% in his last seven games (4-1-2). The Oilers enter Wednesday's game as sizeable -198 home favourites against a Philadelphia Flyers team coming off a 3-1 win over the Vancouver Canucks.

headline: 3-year, $9,750,000 contract with the New Jersey Devils. Expires 2029 (UFA).
Cowan is expected to return to Toronto lineup on Saturday vs. Ottawa.
Stolarz will start Saturday vs. the Oilers.
D'Astous will draw into the lineup on Saturday.
Ekholm (concussion) will be back in the Oilers lineup on Wednesday.
Levi will start vs. New York on Monday.
news: Levi returned from a two-week absence due to a lower-body injury on Saturday and played well, saving 20 of 22 shots (.909 SV%) in a 4-2 win over the Vancouver Canucks. Tristan Jarry played well during Levi's absence, arguably his best stretch of play as an Oiler, but Head Coach Mike Babcock reaffirmed his trust in Levi, returning him on Monday against the New York Rangers. The 24-year-old Levi has a 2.97 GAA and .889 SV% in eight games (7-1-0). The Oilers enter Monday's outing as -157 home favourites against a Rangers team on a three-game winning streak.

headline: Harley (Olympics) will return vs. Seattle on Wednesday.
news: Harley played a prominent role on the blueline for Team Canada during their Silver Medal performance at the Olympics, scoring four points (1G / 3A) in six games, and hopes to carry that momentum back to Dallas. The 24-year-old Harley has 23 points (5G / 18A) in 45 games this season and had five points (3G / 2A) in five games leading into the Olympic break.
